questions.question: Where is Moses speaking in Deuteronomy?
options: Inside Canaan, just after the city of Jericho had fallen
On the plains of Moab, before Israel enters Canaan
At the foot of Mount Sinai in the desert
In the land of Egypt, before the exodus
questions.answer: On the plains of Moab, before Israel enters Canaan

questions.question: What does Moses remind Israel about in chapter 1?
options: Their refusal to enter the land and the spies
The great flood in the days of Noah and the ark
The ten plagues that struck the land of Egypt
The creation of the world in six days and rest
questions.answer: Their refusal to enter the land and the spies

questions.question: Moses recalls appointing leaders to help judge the people.
